meta.name: System Signal
meta.description: A bold experimental portfolio for a fullstack engineer who builds distributed, cloud, and AI-integrated systems.
source_references: UI UX Pro Max portfolio recommendations

neutral.usage: near-black surfaces with progressively brighter text and borders

color.contrast_strategy: high-contrast paper text on near-black with lime reserved for action

font_families.heading: Space Grotesk, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif
font_families.body: DM Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: soft-geometric oversized headlines countered by precise technical monospace metadata

spacing.section_rhythm: large cinematic gaps with compact evidence clusters

layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric strict grid; desktop hero is constrained to one viewport with a two-column support row and proof metrics in the bottom rail

shape.border_usage: quiet translucent 1px borders around independently spaced surfaces

elevation.depth_cues: overlapping layers, border intensity, WebGL depth

iconography.preferred_set: custom inline SVG matching Lucide geometry

motion.entrance_pattern: translateY 24-40px with opacity and compact stagger
motion.philosophy: energetic editorial motion with functional restraint; selected work uses a desktop-only scrubbed card stack to focus one case study at a time

components.button_style: 48px minimum, fully rounded lime primary or translucent secondary, arrow shift hover
components.input_style: dark softly rounded surface, persistent label, lime focus ring
components.card_style: rounded near-black gradient plane with quiet border and asymmetric metadata
components.navigation_pattern: floating translucent horizontal pill across the top on desktop, with a compact always-visible variant below 768px
components.modal_style: large rounded dark sheet with high-contrast close action
components.list_style: softly grouped system-log timeline with numeric markers
components.component_notes: all interactions have default, hover, focus, active, and disabled states; the final contact section is the only light chapter and its contact rows invert from translucent paper to ink

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a live infrastructure console transformed into a softly layered editorial portfolio
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary computational design with rounded tech-premium surfaces

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous around headlines, compact around evidence
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: oversized typography crossed by a full-width field of floating spheres, resolved by a singular light contact chapter
visual_language.focal_strategy: layered depth reveal ending in a high-contrast light CTA destination
visual_language.texture_usage: faint grid, scan-line texture, and restrained concentric rings

composition.hierarchy_method: extreme scale contrast and spatial isolation
composition.negative_space_role: creates confidence and separates narrative beats

imagery.graphic_elements: floating spheres, grid lines, system indexes, brackets, status dots
imagery.image_shape: viewport-spanning 3D depth field and rectangular system panels

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: small translate with lime/cyan edge activation
interaction_feel.transition_personality: snappy with a controlled cinematic entrance
interaction_feel.loading_style: content-first static render; no blocking loader

overview.fallback_strategy: replace WebGL with two static CSS sphere layers and disable scroll motion

background_effects.description: subtle grid and radial light field, a manifesto topology network, and static concentric rings inside the final light contact chapter

params.speed: 13s ambient topology flow; contact rings remain static

particle_systems.description: 34 matte spheres distributed across two depth layers around the hero headline, with a wider desktop bias toward the right side

params.movement_pattern: deterministic quasi-random drift made from mismatched sine and cosine frequencies
params.color_behavior: muted graphite-sage behind the text and pale electric lime in front
params.interaction: nearby spheres are softly repelled by fine-pointer proximity and return with slower damping

3d_elements.description: two transparent sphere canvases sandwich the real HTML headline to create physical-looking foreground and background occlusion

params.renderer: two transparent WebGLRenderer canvases, antialias, DPR clamped 1-1.5
params.lighting: ambient, white directional, and restrained lime/cyan point lights
params.materials: matte StandardMaterials with high roughness and near-zero metalness
params.interaction_model: continuous multi-axis drift plus a cursor-centered radial force; fast outward response and slow damped recovery, disabled for reduced motion and coarse pointers

shader_effects.description: standard materials keep the scene reliable and lightweight

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: triggered for content, scrubbed for progress line

text_effects.description: hero words reveal as clipped lines with compact stagger

image_effects.description: portfolio uses system graphics instead of photography

canvas_drawings.description: Three.js owns the only continuous rendering context

svg_animations.description: small arrow and status glyph micro-interactions plus a low-opacity system topology map behind the manifesto

params.animation_method: GSAP ScrollTrigger draw-on and CSS dash flow
params.stroke_animation: one-time route reveal followed by slow continuous data flow

visual_effects.composite_notes: The CSS grid establishes a static technical field, GSAP stages readable content, and two instanced sphere fields create the experimental signature. The DOM headline sits between the rear and front WebGL layers, so spheres visibly pass behind and in front while following independent, non-obvious drift rhythms. Fine pointers softly displace only nearby spheres; reduced-motion freezes the composition and low-end clients receive matching static CSS sphere layers.
